decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-b0388a31bd06] names the subject and the change: istio-iptables now skips its apply step when the existing rules are compatible, so it can safely run again. The linked issue states who is exposed and what happened before. [ev-404aa4039d8a] and [ev-2166a6422ba7] describe sidecar-injected pods whose istio-init container re-runs without the pod restarting (the kubelet restarts the init container). The re-run failed and left the pod in Init:CrashLoopBackOff, while the app and proxy containers kept working. [ev-548c1f882394] reports a panic in istio-init. This is enough to scope applicability to sidecar-injected workloads that use the istio-init container. Confidence is low because no linked PR is shown and the evidence does not define "compatible" or say whether the CNI path is also affected.
